effect_description_eng: [Main] You may play 1 red [Gemmon] or [Kanata Hondo] from your hand without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area. [Your Turn] When one of your red [ALYSION] trait Digimon attacks, ＜Delay＞. (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect.) ・That Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ and +3000 DP for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
